name: Singing Ads
makes: A 9:16 3D cartoon drama ad that tells the story of the user's own song or narration phrase by phrase, audio unchanged.

steps.name: Assembly and captions with the user's audio

prompts.label: Style block feature-3d
prompts.text:
3D animated feature-film look: smooth, rounded, stylised 3D characters with slightly oversized heads, large expressive eyes with
big irises and bright catchlights, full expressive brows, small soft noses, soft rounded jaws, smooth skin with a gentle warm glow
and rosy cheeks, hair sculpted in soft flowing clumps with fine strands, rounded hands with five fingers; age shows in soft
sculpted wrinkles and grey hair. Clothes in real fabrics with soft folds: fine knit, cotton, corduroy, wool. Sets at real scale
with slightly simplified, rounded forms and clean, finished surfaces: painted plaster, wood, tile, enamel, fabric. Rich, warm
colour: one or two strong, saturated colours from the film's facts in the clothes and the set, against warm neutrals.

prompts.label: Style line
prompts.text:
3D animated feature-film look: smooth, rounded stylised characters with large expressive eyes, warm golden light, rich warm
colours with one or two strong accents, richly dressed real-scale sets with gently rounded forms.

prompts.label: Pace paragraph (clip line 2)
prompts.text: Brisk, energetic real-time pace: every character moves with purpose, about one and a fifth times the speed of a calm everyday pace, snappy and decisive, never slow motion, never drifting or lingering. Every shot opens mid-action and contains one clear story action with a visible cause and result. Fast, punchy feature-animation acting: quick head turns, sharp reactions, big readable poses, eyes and brows snap; hair and cloth whip and settle. Energetic camera: quick push-ins, short whip pans, handheld energy in tense moments, tracking shots that keep up with fast walkers. Warm light with a gentle rim, shallow depth of field. Hard cuts between shots.

prompts.label: Closing paragraph of every clip prompt
prompts.text: The characters act and react without speaking; no voice-over, no narration. No music and no score. No captions, no subtitles, no on-screen text. No slow motion. Every character keeps the exact face, hair, body and clothes of their sheet in every shot; every place matches its location sheet; the <PRODUCT> keeps its exact label.

prompts.label: Clip prompt structure
prompts.text:
- Prompt structure:
  - Line 1: the style line.
  - Line 2, word for word:
    "Brisk, energetic real-time pace: every character moves with purpose, about one and a fifth times the speed of a calm everyday pace, snappy and decisive, never slow motion, never drifting or lingering. Every shot opens mid-action and contains one clear story action with a visible cause and result. Fast, punchy feature-animation acting: quick head turns, sharp reactions, big readable poses, eyes and brows snap; hair and cloth whip and settle. Energetic camera: quick push-ins, short whip pans, handheld energy in tense moments, tracking shots that keep up with fast walkers. Warm light with a gentle rim, shallow depth of field. Hard cuts between shots."
  - Then the @Image bindings.
  - Then the timed shots: "0-3 s: <framing>: <who> <posture> <action with its result>."
  - End with, word for word:
    "The characters act and react without speaking; no voice-over, no narration. No music and no score. No captions, no subtitles, no on-screen text. No slow motion. Every character keeps the exact face, hair, body and clothes of their sheet in every shot; every place matches its location sheet; the <PRODUCT> keeps its exact label."
  - Leave the product clause out of that line in a clip that does not show the product.

prompts.label: Master image instruction
prompts.text: 1. A style-setting master image: the feature-3d style block word for word, plus the main location with the hero and up to two other characters of the story. Write the ages explicitly (e.g. "looks a youthful 51, mostly jet-black hair").

prompts.label: Character sheet
prompts.text: 2. A character sheet per character, with the master attached: front, three-quarter and profile full body, plus a head-and-shoulders close-up, on light grey.

prompts.label: Product sheet
prompts.text: 5. Only when the film has a product: the product sheet, with the master and the product photo (when there is one) attached: front and three-quarter views, "keep the label text and layout exactly".

price: Quoted from estimate calls before the first paid step; about 200 credits of draft clips for a 60 s song, about 960 more to finalize at 1080p.
cheap_price: about 45 credits of clips for 60 s on wan3_0 480p plus about 5 for pictures; free local upscale.
